title: How heavy is each object?
prompt: Place each object from lightest to heaviest.

items.label: A paperclip
items.fact: The standard paperclip is the informal unit for "one gram."

items.label: A smartphone
items.fact: Modern phones hover near 200 g — heavier than most early models, thanks to bigger batteries and glass.

items.label: A bowling ball
items.fact: The maximum legal weight is 16 pounds — about 7.3 kg.

items.label: An adult human
items.fact: The global average adult body mass is about 62 kg.

items.label: A small car
items.fact: A compact car weighs roughly as much as 25 adults.

items.label: An African elephant
items.fact: The largest land animal — a big bull can top 6 tonnes.
